criteria.text: GPT-6 Luna appears in the direct OpenAI API picker when the official live model listing contains GPT-6 Luna and an existing curated model.
If the official live model listing does not contain GPT-6 Luna, selection is rejected and not persisted.
Non-agent OpenAI catalog entries remain excluded from the picker.
The provider label for openai-api matches its canonical Hermes provider label.
The exact GPT-6 Luna target resolves through the official OpenAI Responses transport.

notes: This is a local defect contract; no GitHub issue number was supplied.

The existing official-host picker behavior falls back to the full curated list when the successful live listing has zero curated matches. This behavior is separately characterized by test_official_listing_with_no_curated_intersection_keeps_existing_fallback and is not changed by this contract.

Initial RED: 2 failed, 4 passed. After the two approved source changes, the focused contract and six adjacent suites passed: 42 passed, 0 failed. A first post-change attempt had 41 passed/1 failed because the absent-listing test selected the first curated item, which was Luna after insertion at index 0; Luna was moved after the existing first model to preserve the existing preferred default and make the fixture accurately absent. The immutable test file was not changed.
